# Henri Maasik

> Freelance software developer. I design and build software systems, interfaces and backend infrastructure, with the implementation and background work mattering as much as what people see.

Site: https://mhenri.me/
Also known as: Henri

## Services

- Software development
- Backend engineering
- Infrastructure setup
- Custom storefronts, admin panels and dashboards

## Projects

- Esita Oma Maitse: a complete reconstruction of a production WooCommerce system in custom PHP and MySQL, with two storefronts, a custom admin panel, checkout, order handling and EveryPay payments. https://esitaomamaitse.ee
- Artizon Network: a modular Minecraft network with a proxy, backend, API and game engines, built on Java 25, Gradle, Redis, Docker and MySQL with custom Velocity and Leaf forks.
- FreshFit: a resale platform built with Next.js, Auth.js, Prisma and Neon (PostgreSQL), with catalogue, wardrobe, order management and a dashboard.
